comment: Recognition layer 2 — community/district signs along the Airport→Ochi route. lat/lon are real-world and projected to world space at runtime via road.project(). radius is the trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review marks entries where the owner's lived knowledge should confirm or correct the placement.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow limestone peninsula linking Norman Manley Airport to Kingston — sea on both sides, coconut trees along the strip

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston suburb where the Palisadoes meets the city — Harbour View roundabout into Windward Road

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Windward Road corridor into the city, industrial and residential east of downtown

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Mountain View Avenue neighbourhood — National Stadium, Excelsior High, wareika hills above

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston — historic clock tower at the crossroads

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital on the Rio Cobre plain — White Church, historic square

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in Jamaica (1838) — small hill community on the road toward Bog Walk

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge, one lane, limestone walls either side

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in Saint Catherine — 'Linstead Market, couldn't sell a quattie worth of ackee'

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads village in the cool hills — last stop before Fern Gully and the coast

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival since the 1960s

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre canopied gorge — bamboo and tropical ferns arch over the road

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's premier resort town — Dunn's River Falls, journey's end
